limitations: Non-strict single-flip stability for periodic chains with n>=5 and J>0; no claim about absorbing Glauber states, cooperative flips, dynamics, or equilibrium entropy.
scientific_integrity: The weak-coupling golden-ratio branch is a known baseline; the marginal and strong-frustration polynomial enumerations and their entropy comparison are the focal statements; originality remains subject to independent bibliographic audit.
title: A marginal entropy spike for weakly blocked ANNNI spin chains
